items.body: Retry ordering compares raw durations, bypassing the existing `View<kinds::Duration>` normalization. Reproduced through the committed guest: initial interval `3153600001s`, maximum `3153600000s`, and two attempts produces an ordering violation, although the shared projection and existing retry validator cap both intervals to 100 years. Conversely, initial `{seconds:1,nanos:2000000000}` versus maximum `2s` produces no violation, although the shared projection normalizes the initial interval to `3s`.
